description: A Gurukul that keeps the Vedic oral tradition alive and gives its students a full education, free of charge. Learn why it matters, see a day in the Gurukul, and help keep the voice alive.

arrival.iast: asato mā sadgamaya · tamaso mā jyotirgamaya
arrival.translation: From the unreal, lead me to the real. From darkness, lead me to light.

upi.title: Give by UPI
upi.lede: Scan with any UPI app, or copy the ID and paste it in yours. Any amount is welcome.
upi.qrAlt: QR code to pay {name} through UPI
upi.open: Open any UPI app on your phone
upi.desktopHint: On a computer, scan the code with your phone. The name shown will be {name}.

bank.title: Give by bank transfer
bank.remark: Please use your own name as the remark, or the name of someone you are giving in memory of. We read every one.

whatsapp.label: Message us on WhatsApp
whatsapp.text: Namaste. I found the Ved Vidyalaya Foundation website and would like to get in touch.

footer.blurb: A Gurukul that keeps the Vedic oral tradition alive and gives its students a full education, free of charge.
footer.madeWith: Made with care, in three languages.
footer.noTrackers: No cookies, no trackers. Nothing is collected when you visit.
footer.mottoGloss: The Veda is the root of all dharma. The Vedas are for the good of all.

notFound.body: The page you were looking for is not here. It may have moved, or the link may have been copied wrongly. Everything on the site is one step away from the home page.
